title: Test-phase machines
statement: Given three finite Turing machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ over the Boolean alphabet, associate a multi-tape Turing machine to each test-machine phase. Each machine has $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P$ work tapes, where $k_V,k_I,k_P$ are the respective work-tape counts, and uses the phase-indexed test states for $M_V$ and $M_I$.
hypotheses_covered: three finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
